orders.title: Work orders
orders.description: Browse work orders by state; select a row to inspect details and run state transitions below.
orders.empty: No work orders under the current filter

create.title: Create work order
create.description: Project name is required; project manager / sales rep can be picked from candidates (display names) or pasted as user ids (the project manager is the first-level approver of parts requests; if both are left empty, parts approvals will be unhandled).
create.manager: Project manager (optional, pick from candidates or paste user id)
create.sales-rep: Sales rep (optional, pick from candidates or paste user id)
create.candidate-placeholder: Pick from candidates, or paste a user id

detail.title: Work order details and actions
detail.description: Inspect the main document and progress; run state transitions, close, attachment linking and kit readiness refresh.

warning.both-missing: No project manager and sales rep set: first-level approval of parts requests will be unhandled; complete the owners when creating the work order.
warning.manager-missing: No project manager set: first-level approval of parts requests falls to the sales rep.

kit-check.heading: Latest kit readiness check
kit-check.empty: No kit readiness check yet (run "Refresh kit readiness check" below)

progress.assembly-empty: No assembly and commissioning progress data

kit-board.title: Kit readiness board
kit-board.description: Latest kit readiness snapshot per work order: listing demand vs available stock; assembly/electrical dispatches with gaps are blocked.
kit-board.empty: No kit readiness snapshots yet (generated after running "Refresh kit readiness check" on a selected work order)

parts.title: Parts requests
parts.description: Parts requests enter approval after submission and can ship once approved (linked stock issue); select a row to inspect the approval progress below.
parts.empty: No parts requests under the current filter
parts.role-note: Actions are role-gated: approve / reject require the parts approval permission (approver role); shipping (linked stock issue) requires the shipping permission. Without the matching permission, the operation is rejected and has no effect.

action.target-id: Target request id (from the table above)
action.target-id-placeholder: Paste an id from the table above

errors.target-not-in-list: Target request id is not in the current list

create.title: New parts request
create.description: Requests enter approval immediately; the first-level approver is the work order's project manager (falling back to the sales rep if unset). Pick an item from candidates (code and name shown; the item id is submitted) or paste an item id.
create.item-label: Item (pick from candidates or paste item id)

approval.title: Parts request details and approval progress
approval.description: Current approval level and approvers resolved live; the first-level approver = the work order's project manager (falling back to the sales rep if unset).
approval.no-approver: No approver at this level: {{note}} — approval cannot proceed; complete the work order owners or approval role configuration first.
approval.no-pending: No pending approval stage (approved requests can be shipped).
